phase: Phase 22I: Live Observation Readiness & Operational Audit

feature_name_warnings.root_cause: Unit tests in test_phase21b_tuning.py and test_phase21_candidate_compatibility.py passed raw Python lists to encoder.transform() without column names, triggering scikit-learn 1.2+ UserWarnings. Production scoring (score_bridge_risk.py) and candidate shadow scoring (validate_shadow_mode_phase22c.py) already pass pd.DataFrame(cat_matrix, columns=CATEGORICAL_FEATURES) and emit 0 warnings.
feature_name_warnings.remediation: Updated unit test helpers to supply column names via DataFrame; verified 0 UserWarnings across all 143 backend tests under -W error::UserWarning.

test_traffic_leakage_audit.issue_discovered: Unauthenticated API test runs against /api/score previously defaulted traffic source to LIVE_OPERATIONAL, incrementing observation_tracker_state.json to 204 records and 2 days elapsed, in conflict with the zero-fabrication NOT_STARTED status reported in Phase 22H.
remediation: Hardened ShadowIngestionAdapter.authenticate_request: unauthenticated callers are never marked operational_authorized.
Hardened traffic source routing: unauthenticated callers and test keys claiming LIVE_OPERATIONAL are automatically remapped to SYNTHETIC_TEST.
Hardened get_readiness_assessment: requires verified operational client authorization before marking traffic confirmed or observation started.
Reset DEFAULT_TRACKER_STATE_PATH to pristine NOT_STARTED state (0 records, 0 days).
Verified after full test run that tracker remains at 0 records, 0 days, and CONNECTION_VERIFIED status.

observation_operations.clock_isolation_policy: Strict UTC 30-consecutive-calendar-day observation window. Starts strictly upon first authentic LIVE_OPERATIONAL record from an authorized operational client. Test credentials, synthetic traffic, and local development requests are strictly prevented from advancing the clock.
observation_operations.zero_fabrication_status: VERIFIED — Live observation has NOT commenced (0/30 days elapsed).

outcome_dependent_metrics.scientific_disclaimer: Ground truth deck condition degradation ratings (DECK_2025 < DECK_2023) require physical biennial bridge inspections conducted by certified DOT bridge inspection engineers. Unlabeled operational predictions cannot produce verified outcome metrics.

external_prerequisites_checklist.required_action: State DOT IT security must provision and configure BRIDGE_INGEST_API_KEY in production environment.
Configure network routing and firewalls between DOT bridge management systems and platform /api/score endpoints.
Route live operational bridge records with X-Traffic-Source: LIVE_OPERATIONAL.
Formal written approval from State DOT chief bridge engineers following completion of 30-day observation window.

decision_verdict.decision_rationale: The ingestion gateway, shadow scoring service, telemetry validation, and failure isolation pipelines are fully verified and operational. However, starting authentic live observation is BLOCKED on external State DOT credential assignment and live traffic ingress. Zero-fabrication governance strictly forbids starting the 30-day streak without genuine operational DOT traffic.
